headline: Nevish Line Slips to Four-Three as Hourly Toll Soars
war_summary: Since our last edition the Nevish Line has slipped from six Warden stands to a four-three split with one in ruin, even as its dead mount fastest of any front — Warden losses topping a thousand an hour in the latest reading, Colonial near six hundred. The Weathered Expanse logged fifty-one base events in the past day, most of any region, yet holds at five Warden stands to two Colonial with two in ruin; the Line's forty-two and Linn Mercy's thirty-seven follow, the Line's flags turning again a quarter hour before press time about Blackcoat Way and Tomb Father. Linn Mercy reads eight Colonial stands to two Warden with one in ruin, Warden dead running near double the Colonial count about Lathair and Outwich Ranch. Stonecradle has stirred afresh at The Reach and World's End, only one stand of nine in Warden hands. Callahans Passage runs second to the Line in hourly losses, its ten Warden stands unbroken. Mooring County, quiet for flags since mid-morning, has flared in the past two hours; Marban Hollow and Stlican Shelf stay still. It is day 742; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
